<translated_code>
#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class D {
public:
    class IO {
    public:
        std::istream& in;
        std::ostream& out;
        IO() : in(std::cin), out(std::cout) {}
        void println(const auto& x) { out << x << "\n"; }
        void print(const auto& x) { out << x; }
        void close() {}
        int nextInt() {
            int x; in >> x; return x;
        }
        long long nextLong() {
            long long x; in >> x; return x;
        }
        std::string next() {
            std::string s; in >> s; return s;
        }
        double nextDouble() {
            double x; in >> x; return x;
        }
    };

    class Solver {
    public:
        IO io;
        Solver() {
            try {
                solve();
            } catch (const std::string& e) {
                if (e != "Clean exit") throw;
            } finally {
                io.close();
            }
        }

        void solve() {
            long long n = io.nextLong();
            long long m = io.nextLong();
            if (m < n) {
                long long helper = m;
                m = n;
                n = helper;
            }

            if (n == 1) {
                io.println(brute1(m));
                return;
            }
            if (n == 2) {
                if (m < 3) io.println(0);
                else if (m == 3) io.println(4);
                else if (m == 7) io.println(12);
                else io.println(2 * m);
                return;
            }

            // general case solution:
            io.println(2 * (n * m / 2));
        }

        long long brute1(long long m) {
            long long ans = 6 * (m / 6);
            if (m % 6 == 5) ans += 4;
            else if (m % 6 == 4) ans += 2;
            return ans;
        }
    };
};

int main() {
    D::Solver solver;
    return 0;
}
